title: A check that bounds a tool's git calls counts every git process, not one helper's calls
goal: A planned check or test that bounds the git calls of a tool (ST-nkg2ucxq's check counted only kg_merge.git, while the cat-file --batch reader and a git config read go around it, so its limit of 6 would pass 8 real processes) counts subprocess.Popen of git instead; kb/_self/backlog.md's rule for checks that measure a count says to measure the real thing (found by the SP-yzgetyu2 review)
